title: Patch In, Exploit Out: How deepsec Reconstructed the Pwn2Own Microsoft Edge Sandbox Escape
excerpt: On May 14, 2026, security researcher Orange Tsai demonstrated a Microsoft Edge sandbox escape at Pwn2Own Berlin, one of the world’s premier hacking competitions. He was the only contestant to win the browser category, earning $175,000. The organizers later revealed that his exploit chained together four logic bugs rather than relying on the memory-corruption vulnerabilities commonly used in browser exploitation. The news sparked intense discussion across the global security community, but the mechanics of the attack remained unknown.
content_html:
On May 14, 2026, security researcher Orange Tsai demonstrated a Microsoft Edge sandbox escape at Pwn2Own Berlin, one of the world’s premier hacking competitions. He was the only contestant to win the browser category, earning $175,000. The organizers later revealed that his exploit chained together four logic bugs rather than relying on the memory-corruption vulnerabilities commonly used in browser exploitation. The news sparked intense discussion across the global security community, but the mechanics of the attack remained unknown.

For the next two months, technical details remained limited to the information in Microsoft’s security advisories, and no third party publicly reproduced the attack. Now, for the first time, the PoC Agent in our AI-powered security system, deepsec, has reconstructed every step and produced a working reproduction of the exploit.

The Limitations of Traditional Patch Analysis

Analyzing security patches from vendors such as Microsoft and Apple is an important part of security programs within enterprises and critical infrastructure organizations. This work helps teams determine the real-world impact of vulnerabilities, assess how quickly attackers may weaponize them, independently verify whether patches fully address the underlying issues, and develop detection and mitigation capabilities.

In this case, however, the vulnerabilities were buried in the massive Edge codebase, with a single binary module exceeding 300 MB. Applying traditional binary diffing at this scale demands substantial expert effort. After loading the target module and its debugging symbols into a tool such as IDA, the resulting IDB can reach 5 GB, making analysis extremely time-consuming.

Moreover, non-semantic changes introduced by compiler optimizations and function reordering generate large amounts of noise unrelated to the target vulnerabilities. In this Edge update, more than 32,000 functions differed between the vulnerable and patched versions, making the security-critical fixes even harder to isolate.

Unlike memory-corruption vulnerabilities, logic bugs depend heavily on code context and application semantics. Examining changed functions in isolation is rarely enough to reconstruct their full security implications.

Our subsequent review found that the logic bugs in this Edge exploit chain were spread across several unrelated modules, including navigation validation, asynchronous tab selection, and feedback-log processing. Even after locating an individual fix, it was difficult to determine what exploit primitive the underlying vulnerability provided, let alone how to chain it with the others.

During our research, we found that AI significantly accelerated semantic analysis and the discovery of relationships across modules. Based on this insight, we implemented an automated differential analysis framework within deepsec, integrating binary diffing tools, the PoC Agent platform, and DARKNAVY’s security research knowledge base into a unified workflow.

We used this complex Edge exploit chain as a test case to determine whether deepsec could reconstruct the full chain using only the pre- and post-patch binaries and the limited information available from Microsoft.

Working Backward from the End: A Path-Traversal File-Write Primitive

Faced with an unknown exploit chain, deepsec began at the end, using the vulnerability advisories to identify the primitive with the clearest expected behavior.

deepsec first identified a clear security fix in Edge’s feedback component: file-writing functionality present in the vulnerable version had been removed from the patched version. Further analysis showed that the vulnerable interface contained a path-traversal flaw, providing the arbitrary file-write primitive needed at the end of the exploit chain. With additional exploitation techniques, this primitive could be turned into remote code execution on Windows.

deepsec also identified the precondition for triggering the vulnerable interface: the attacker needed to execute JavaScript on a privileged page that exposed the edgeFeedbackPrivate API.

The final portion of the exploit chain was now clear:

JavaScript execution on a privileged page → Call the edgeFeedbackPrivate API → Write a file through path traversal → Windows RCE

The next question was how an attacker could reach this privileged execution environment from an ordinary web page.

Breaking Navigation Restrictions: Arbitrary URL Navigation

Following the advisory’s reference to “navigation handling,” deepsec performed targeted differential analysis of the relevant components. It located the CA Guidance navigation component and identified several security fixes, with the most important changes concentrated in EdgeCAGuidanceNavigationThrottle::WillStartRequest.

The vulnerable version used the switch_profile parameter directly as the navigation target, without restricting special schemes such as javascript:. The patched version introduced a URL-scheme allowlist.

Navigation-source validation also changed. The vulnerable version called GetVisibleURL to retrieve the URL currently displayed in the tab and used it to determine whether the navigation originated from a Microsoft sign-in page. The patched version instead called GetInitiatorOrigin to validate the navigation’s actual initiator.

At first glance, this appeared to be a simple change in which URL source was used for validation. However, deepsec identified a subtle but important difference between the security implications of the two approaches: in the vulnerable version, an untrusted context could control navigation of the page whose URL was being validated.

An attacker could first navigate a tab under their control to a Microsoft sign-in page, then trigger the subsequent navigation from an untrusted context. This meant that the tab whose visible URL passed validation could differ from the context that initiated the navigation, allowing the attacker to bypass the source restriction.

Even after bypassing source validation, however, the renderer process still could not navigate directly to edge://guidance-ca-error. The exploit chain therefore remained blocked at its entry point.

Further analysis by deepsec uncovered an unpatched validation gap that could be used to enter the same processing path: the component compared only the host of the entry URL and did not validate its scheme. An attacker could therefore use https://guidance-ca-error/ to reach the same logic, bypassing the renderer’s restriction against direct navigation to the privileged edge:// scheme. Once inside that flow, the attacker could set switch_profile to either a privileged page or a javascript: URL.

Malicious page → CA Guidance navigation → Arbitrary URL navigation → javascript: URL or privileged page

deepsec now had an arbitrary URL-navigation primitive, but this was still not enough to complete the exploit.

The Final Piece: Achieving UXSS

The vulnerabilities identified so far suggested the overall direction of the attack:

Navigation-validation bypass → UXSS → Privileged API access → Path-traversal file write

One critical piece was still missing.

The attacker could initiate arbitrary navigation from a Microsoft sign-in page, execute code on the current page via a javascript: URL, or navigate to a privileged page. However, these capabilities could not be combined directly. After navigating to a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API, the attacker still needed a way to execute JavaScript within that page’s context.

For a time, deepsec’s analysis reached an impasse.

deepsec also identified several suspicious fixes in other modules. For example, the vulnerable version of QuickAuth lacked necessary restrictions on navigation targets, while the patched version introduced a target allowlist and other security checks. As the number of candidates grew, determining the true exploit path became increasingly difficult.

At this point, deepsec had to prioritize candidates much like a human researcher: which fixes represented independent issues in adjacent attack surfaces, and which changes could provide the missing link in the current exploit chain?

After exploring several directions in parallel, deepsec concluded that QuickAuth and the other candidates lacked the conditions required for exploitation. It therefore focused its subsequent analysis on the CA Guidance path.

By tracing the flow downstream from HandleCAErrorPageGuidance, deepsec found the most subtle flaw in the entire chain: an object-binding error.

When the email parameter matched the current profile, HandleCAErrorPageGuidance used an asynchronous PostTask to navigate to the URL specified by switch_profile.

In the vulnerable version, the lambda captured a WeakPtr<Browser> referring to the browser window. The navigation used the CURRENT_TAB disposition but was not bound to a specific tab. At runtime, Navigate called GetActiveWebContents to retrieve the tab that was active at that moment and performed the navigation there.

The patched version instead captured a WeakPtr<WebContents> for a specific tab, ensuring that the target URL was loaded in that same tab.

At first glance, this appeared to be an implementation detail with no obvious security significance. In the context of the exploit chain, however, deepsec recognized that the vulnerable implementation broke the binding between the object that passed the security check and the object on which the operation was ultimately performed.

Because the lambda executed asynchronously, the browser’s active tab could change between the time the task was posted and the time it ran. Consequently, the tab whose visible URL passed the Microsoft sign-in check and the tab in which JavaScript was ultimately executed did not have to be the same.

An attacker could construct a multi-stage navigation sequence: first, navigate one tab to the Microsoft sign-in page so that its visible URL would pass validation; then, before the asynchronous task executed, make the privileged target page the active tab.

This allowed the attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API, completing the UXSS primitive.

The full exploit chain was now complete. First, the attacker initiated a CA Guidance navigation from a malicious page and exploited the entry URL’s host-only validation to reach the relevant processing path. Next, the attacker bypassed the flawed navigation-source validation and missing target-scheme restriction to obtain arbitrary URL navigation. Finally, the attacker exploited the object-binding error in the asynchronous navigation flow to switch the active tab and execute JavaScript on a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API. From there, the attacker could call the vulnerable feedback interface, use path traversal to write an arbitrary file, and ultimately achieve remote code execution on Windows.

deepsec then developed and debugged a working exploit in a Windows virtual machine, validating the complete chain.

Conclusion

This experiment demonstrates that deepsec can combine patch diffing, semantic analysis, browser security knowledge, and dynamic validation to reconstruct individual exploit primitives and determine how they fit together—even when public information is scarce, the target binaries are exceptionally large, and the vulnerabilities span unrelated components.

The release of a security patch by an upstream vendor such as Microsoft does not mean that every endpoint is immediately protected. Large enterprises often need to complete testing, deployment, and system restarts before an update can be fully rolled out, leaving an exposure window that may last for days or even months.

In the past, downstream organizations often took comfort in the assumption that attackers would struggle to reconstruct complex vulnerabilities quickly and that large-scale exploitation would remain prohibitively expensive.

As AI-driven security capabilities continue to mature, however, the time between patch release and successful weaponization will shrink dramatically.

Defenses built around that time gap may soon cease to be reliable.

blocks.html_en: Following the advisory’s reference to “navigation handling,” deepsec performed targeted differential analysis of the relevant components. It located the CA Guidance navigation component and identified several security fixes, with the most important changes concentrated in EdgeCAGuidanceNavigationThrottle::WillStartRequest.

sentences.en: Following the advisory’s reference to “navigation handling,” deepsec performed targeted differential analysis of the relevant components.
sentences.zh: 根据该通报提到的“导航处理”，deepsec 对相关组件进行了有针对性的差异分析。

sentences.en: It located the CA Guidance navigation component and identified several security fixes, with the most important changes concentrated in EdgeCAGuidanceNavigationThrottle::WillStartRequest.
sentences.zh: 它找到了 CA Guidance 导航组件并确定了多个安全修复程序，其中最重要的更改集中在 EdgeCAGuidanceNavigationThrottle::WillStartRequest 中。

sentences.en: Navigation-source and target-scheme validation in the patched version

blocks.html_en: The vulnerable version used the switch_profile parameter directly as the navigation target, without restricting special schemes such as javascript:. The patched version introduced a URL-scheme allowlist.

sentences.en: The vulnerable version used the switch_profile parameter directly as the navigation target, without restricting special schemes such as javascript:.
sentences.zh: 漏洞版本直接使用switch_profile参数作为导航目标，没有限制javascript:等特殊方案。

sentences.en: The patched version introduced a URL-scheme allowlist.
sentences.zh: 修补版本引入了 URL 方案白名单。

blocks.html_en: Navigation-source validation also changed. The vulnerable version called GetVisibleURL to retrieve the URL currently displayed in the tab and used it to determine whether the navigation originated from a Microsoft sign-in page. The patched version instead called GetInitiatorOrigin to validate the navigation’s actual initiator.

sentences.en: Navigation-source validation also changed.
sentences.zh: 导航源验证也发生了变化。

sentences.en: The vulnerable version called GetVisibleURL to retrieve the URL currently displayed in the tab and used it to determine whether the navigation originated from a Microsoft sign-in page.
sentences.zh: 易受攻击的版本称为 GetVisibleURL，用于检索选项卡中当前显示的 URL，并使用它来确定导航是否源自 Microsoft 登录页面。

sentences.en: The patched version instead called GetInitiatorOrigin to validate the navigation’s actual initiator.
sentences.zh: 修补后的版本改为调用 GetInitiatorOrigin 来验证导航的实际启动器。

blocks.html_en: At first glance, this appeared to be a simple change in which URL source was used for validation. However, deepsec identified a subtle but important difference between the security implications of the two approaches: in the vulnerable version, an untrusted context could control navigation of the page whose URL was being validated.

sentences.en: At first glance, this appeared to be a simple change in which URL source was used for validation.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这似乎是一个简单的更改，其中使用 URL 源进行验证。

sentences.en: However, deepsec identified a subtle but important difference between the security implications of the two approaches: in the vulnerable version, an untrusted context could control navigation of the page whose URL was being validated.
sentences.zh: 然而，deepsec 发现了两种方法的安全隐患之间存在微妙但重要的区别：在易受攻击的版本中，不受信任的上下文可以控制正在验证 URL 的页面的导航。

blocks.html_en: An attacker could first navigate a tab under their control to a Microsoft sign-in page, then trigger the subsequent navigation from an untrusted context. This meant that the tab whose visible URL passed validation could differ from the context that initiated the navigation, allowing the attacker to bypass the source restriction.

sentences.en: An attacker could first navigate a tab under their control to a Microsoft sign-in page, then trigger the subsequent navigation from an untrusted context.
sentences.zh: 攻击者可以首先将其控制下的选项卡导航到 Microsoft 登录页面，然后从不受信任的上下文触发后续导航。

sentences.en: This meant that the tab whose visible URL passed validation could differ from the context that initiated the navigation, allowing the attacker to bypass the source restriction.
sentences.zh: 这意味着其可见 URL 通过验证的选项卡可能与启动导航的上下文不同，从而允许攻击者绕过源限制。

blocks.html_en: Even after bypassing source validation, however, the renderer process still could not navigate directly to edge://guidance-ca-error. The exploit chain therefore remained blocked at its entry point.

sentences.en: Even after bypassing source validation, however, the renderer process still could not navigate directly to edge://guidance-ca-error.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使绕过源验证，渲染器进程仍然无法直接导航到edge://guidance-ca-error。

sentences.en: The exploit chain therefore remained blocked at its entry point.
sentences.zh: 因此，漏洞利用链的入口点仍然被阻止。

blocks.html_en: Further analysis by deepsec uncovered an unpatched validation gap that could be used to enter the same processing path: the component compared only the host of the entry URL and did not validate its scheme. An attacker could therefore use https://guidance-ca-error/ to reach the same logic, bypassing the renderer’s restriction against direct navigation to the privileged edge:// scheme. Once inside that flow, the attacker could set switch_profile to either a privileged page or a javascript: URL.

sentences.en: Further analysis by deepsec uncovered an unpatched validation gap that could be used to enter the same processing path: the component compared only the host of the entry URL and did not validate its scheme.
sentences.zh: Deepsec 的进一步分析发现了一个未修补的验证间隙，可用于输入相同的处理路径：该组件仅比较条目 URL 的主机，而不验证其方案。

sentences.en: An attacker could therefore use https://guidance-ca-error/ to reach the same logic, bypassing the renderer’s restriction against direct navigation to the privileged edge:// scheme.
sentences.zh: 因此，攻击者可以使用 https://guidance-ca-error/ 来达到相同的逻辑，绕过渲染器对直接导航到特权 Edge:// 方案的限制。

sentences.en: Once inside that flow, the attacker could set switch_profile to either a privileged page or a javascript: URL.
sentences.zh: 一旦进入该流程，攻击者就可以将 switch_profile 设置为特权页面或 javascript: URL。

However, these capabilities could not be combined directly. After navigating to a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API, the attacker still needed a way to execute JavaScript within that page’s context.

sentences.en: However, these capabilities could not be combined directly.
sentences.zh: 但是，这些功能无法直接组合。

blocks.html_en: deepsec also identified several suspicious fixes in other modules. For example, the vulnerable version of QuickAuth lacked necessary restrictions on navigation targets, while the patched version introduced a target allowlist and other security checks. As the number of candidates grew, determining the true exploit path became increasingly difficult.

sentences.en: deepsec also identified several suspicious fixes in other modules.
sentences.zh: deepsec 还在其他模块中发现了一些可疑的修复。

sentences.en: For example, the vulnerable version of QuickAuth lacked necessary restrictions on navigation targets, while the patched version introduced a target allowlist and other security checks.
sentences.zh: 例如，QuickAuth 的易受攻击版本缺乏对导航目标的必要限制，而修补版本则引入了目标白名单和其他安全检查。

sentences.en: As the number of candidates grew, determining the true exploit path became increasingly difficult.
sentences.zh: 随着候选人数量的增加，确定真正的漏洞利用路径变得越来越困难。

blocks.html_en: At this point, deepsec had to prioritize candidates much like a human researcher: which fixes represented independent issues in adjacent attack surfaces, and which changes could provide the missing link in the current exploit chain?

sentences.en: At this point, deepsec had to prioritize candidates much like a human researcher: which fixes represented independent issues in adjacent attack surfaces, and which changes could provide the missing link in the current exploit chain?
sentences.zh: 此时，deepsec 必须像人类研究人员一样对候选者进行优先级排序：哪些修复代表了相邻攻击面中的独立问题，哪些更改可以提供当前漏洞利用链中缺失的链接？

blocks.html_en: After exploring several directions in parallel, deepsec concluded that QuickAuth and the other candidates lacked the conditions required for exploitation. It therefore focused its subsequent analysis on the CA Guidance path.

sentences.en: After exploring several directions in parallel, deepsec concluded that QuickAuth and the other candidates lacked the conditions required for exploitation.
sentences.zh: 在并行探索多个方向后，deepsec 得出结论，QuickAuth 和其他候选者缺乏利用所需的条件。

sentences.en: It therefore focused its subsequent analysis on the CA Guidance path.
sentences.zh: 因此，其后续分析的重点是 CA 指导路径。

blocks.html_en: By tracing the flow downstream from HandleCAErrorPageGuidance, deepsec found the most subtle flaw in the entire chain: an object-binding error.

sentences.en: By tracing the flow downstream from HandleCAErrorPageGuidance, deepsec found the most subtle flaw in the entire chain: an object-binding error.
sentences.zh: 通过跟踪 HandleCAErrorPageGuidance 的下游流程，deepsec 发现了整个链中最微妙的缺陷：对象绑定错误。

sentences.en: Asynchronous navigation bound to a specific WebContents
sentences.zh: 绑定到特定 WebContents 的异步导航

blocks.html_en: Asynchronous navigation bound to a specific WebContents

sentences.en: Asynchronous navigation bound to a specific WebContents
sentences.zh: 绑定到特定 WebContents 的异步导航

blocks.html_en: When the email parameter matched the current profile, HandleCAErrorPageGuidance used an asynchronous PostTask to navigate to the URL specified by switch_profile.

sentences.en: When the email parameter matched the current profile, HandleCAErrorPageGuidance used an asynchronous PostTask to navigate to the URL specified by switch_profile.
sentences.zh: 当 email 参数与当前配置文件匹配时，HandleCAErrorPageGuidance 使用异步 PostTask 导航到 switch_profile 指定的 URL。

blocks.html_en: In the vulnerable version, the lambda captured a WeakPtr<Browser> referring to the browser window. The navigation used the CURRENT_TAB disposition but was not bound to a specific tab. At runtime, Navigate called GetActiveWebContents to retrieve the tab that was active at that moment and performed the navigation there.

sentences.en: In the vulnerable version, the lambda captured a WeakPtr<Browser> referring to the browser window.
sentences.zh: 在存在漏洞的版本中，lambda 捕获了引用浏览器窗口的 WeakPtr<Browser> 。

sentences.en: The navigation used the CURRENT_TAB disposition but was not bound to a specific tab.
sentences.zh: 导航使用 CURRENT_TAB 配置，但未绑定到特定选项卡。

sentences.en: At runtime, Navigate called GetActiveWebContents to retrieve the tab that was active at that moment and performed the navigation there.
sentences.zh: 在运行时，Navigate 调用 GetActiveWebContents 来检索当时处于活动状态的选项卡并在那里执行导航。

blocks.html_en: The patched version instead captured a WeakPtr<WebContents> for a specific tab, ensuring that the target URL was loaded in that same tab.

sentences.en: The patched version instead captured a WeakPtr<WebContents> for a specific tab, ensuring that the target URL was loaded in that same tab.
sentences.zh: 修补后的版本改为捕获特定选项卡的 WeakPtr<WebContents>，确保目标 URL 加载到同一选项卡中。

blocks.html_en: At first glance, this appeared to be an implementation detail with no obvious security significance. In the context of the exploit chain, however, deepsec recognized that the vulnerable implementation broke the binding between the object that passed the security check and the object on which the operation was ultimately performed.

sentences.en: At first glance, this appeared to be an implementation detail with no obvious security significance.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这似乎是一个没有明显安全意义的实现细节。

sentences.en: In the context of the exploit chain, however, deepsec recognized that the vulnerable implementation broke the binding between the object that passed the security check and the object on which the operation was ultimately performed.
sentences.zh: 然而，在漏洞利用链的上下文中，deepsec 认识到该漏洞的实现破坏了通过安全检查的对象与最终执行操作的对象之间的绑定。

blocks.html_en: Because the lambda executed asynchronously, the browser’s active tab could change between the time the task was posted and the time it ran. Consequently, the tab whose visible URL passed the Microsoft sign-in check and the tab in which JavaScript was ultimately executed did not have to be the same.

sentences.en: Because the lambda executed asynchronously, the browser’s active tab could change between the time the task was posted and the time it ran.
sentences.zh: 由于 lambda 是异步执行的，因此浏览器的活动选项卡可能会在任务发布时间和运行时间之间发生变化。

sentences.en: Consequently, the tab whose visible URL passed the Microsoft sign-in check and the tab in which JavaScript was ultimately executed did not have to be the same.
sentences.zh: 因此，可见 URL 通过 Microsoft 登录检查的选项卡和最终执行 JavaScript 的选项卡不必相同。

blocks.html_en: An attacker could construct a multi-stage navigation sequence: first, navigate one tab to the Microsoft sign-in page so that its visible URL would pass validation; then, before the asynchronous task executed, make the privileged target page the active tab.

sentences.en: An attacker could construct a multi-stage navigation sequence: first, navigate one tab to the Microsoft sign-in page so that its visible URL would pass validation; then, before the asynchronous task executed, make the privileged target page the active tab.
sentences.zh: 攻击者可以构建多阶段导航序列：首先，将一个选项卡导航到 Microsoft 登录页面，以便其可见 URL 通过验证；然后，在执行异步任务之前，将特权目标页面设置为活动选项卡。

blocks.html_en: This allowed the attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API, completing the UXSS primitive.

sentences.en: This allowed the attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API, completing the UXSS primitive.
sentences.zh: 这允许攻击者在暴露 EdgeFeedbackPrivate API 的特权页面上下文中执行任意 JavaScript，从而完成 UXSS 原语。

blocks.html_en: The full exploit chain was now complete. First, the attacker initiated a CA Guidance navigation from a malicious page and exploited the entry URL’s host-only validation to reach the relevant processing path. Next, the attacker bypassed the flawed navigation-source validation and missing target-scheme restriction to obtain arbitrary URL navigation. Finally, the attacker exploited the object-binding error in the asynchronous navigation flow to switch the active tab and execute JavaScript on a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API. From there, the attacker could call the vulnerable feedback interface, use path traversal to write an arbitrary file, and ultimately achieve remote code execution on Windows.

sentences.en: The full exploit chain was now complete.
sentences.zh: 完整的漏洞利用链现已完成。

sentences.en: First, the attacker initiated a CA Guidance navigation from a malicious page and exploited the entry URL’s host-only validation to reach the relevant processing path.
sentences.zh: 首先，攻击者从恶意页面启动 CA Guidance 导航，并利用条目 URL 的仅主机验证来到达相关处理路径。

sentences.en: Next, the attacker bypassed the flawed navigation-source validation and missing target-scheme restriction to obtain arbitrary URL navigation.
sentences.zh: 接下来，攻击者绕过有缺陷的导航源验证和缺失的目标方案限制来获取任意 URL 导航。

sentences.en: Finally, the attacker exploited the object-binding error in the asynchronous navigation flow to switch the active tab and execute JavaScript on a privileged page exposing the edgeFeedbackPrivate API.
sentences.zh: 最后，攻击者利用异步导航流中的对象绑定错误来切换活动选项卡并在暴露 EdgeFeedbackPrivate API 的特权页面上执行 JavaScript。

sentences.en: From there, the attacker could call the vulnerable feedback interface, use path traversal to write an arbitrary file, and ultimately achieve remote code execution on Windows.
sentences.zh: 由此，攻击者可以调用存在漏洞的反馈接口，利用路径遍历写入任意文件，最终在Windows上实现远程代码执行。

blocks.html_en: Conclusion

sentences.en: Conclusion
sentences.zh: 结论

blocks.html_en: This experiment demonstrates that deepsec can combine patch diffing, semantic analysis, browser security knowledge, and dynamic validation to reconstruct individual exploit primitives and determine how they fit together—even when public information is scarce, the target binaries are exceptionally large, and the vulnerabilities span unrelated components.

sentences.en: This experiment demonstrates that deepsec can combine patch diffing, semantic analysis, browser security knowledge, and dynamic validation to reconstruct individual exploit primitives and determine how they fit together—even when public information is scarce, the target binaries are exceptionally large, and the vulnerabilities span unrelated components.
sentences.zh: 该实验表明，deepsec 可以结合补丁比较、语义分析、浏览器安全知识和动态验证来重建各个漏洞利用原语并确定它们如何组合在一起 - 即使公共信息稀缺，目标二进制文件异常大，并且漏洞跨越不相关的组件。

blocks.html_en: The release of a security patch by an upstream vendor such as Microsoft does not mean that every endpoint is immediately protected. Large enterprises often need to complete testing, deployment, and system restarts before an update can be fully rolled out, leaving an exposure window that may last for days or even months.

sentences.en: The release of a security patch by an upstream vendor such as Microsoft does not mean that every endpoint is immediately protected.
sentences.zh: Microsoft 等上游供应商发布安全补丁并不意味着每个端点都会立即受到保护。

sentences.en: Large enterprises often need to complete testing, deployment, and system restarts before an update can be fully rolled out, leaving an exposure window that may last for days or even months.
sentences.zh: 大型企业通常需要完成测试、部署和系统重启才能全面推出更新，从而留下可能持续数天甚至数月的暴露窗口。

blocks.html_en: In the past, downstream organizations often took comfort in the assumption that attackers would struggle to reconstruct complex vulnerabilities quickly and that large-scale exploitation would remain prohibitively expensive.

sentences.en: In the past, downstream organizations often took comfort in the assumption that attackers would struggle to reconstruct complex vulnerabilities quickly and that large-scale exploitation would remain prohibitively expensive.
sentences.zh: 过去，下游组织经常相信攻击者将难以快速重建复杂的漏洞，并且大规模利用的成本仍然高昂。

blocks.html_en: As AI-driven security capabilities continue to mature, however, the time between patch release and successful weaponization will shrink dramatically.

sentences.en: As AI-driven security capabilities continue to mature, however, the time between patch release and successful weaponization will shrink dramatically.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着人工智能驱动的安全能力不断成熟，补丁发布和成功武器化之间的时间将大幅缩短。

blocks.html_en: Defenses built around that time gap may soon cease to be reliable.

sentences.en: Defenses built around that time gap may soon cease to be reliable.
sentences.zh: 围绕这个时间间隔建立的防御可能很快就会不再可靠。

content_html_zh:
2026 年 5 月 14 日，安全研究员 Orange Tsai 在全球顶级黑客竞赛之一的 Pwn2Own Berlin 上演示了 Microsoft Edge 沙箱逃逸。 他是唯一一位赢得浏览器类别冠军的参赛者，获得了 175,000 美元的奖金。 组织者后来透露，他的利用将四个逻辑错误链接在一起，而不是依赖于浏览器利用中常用的内存损坏漏洞。 这一消息引发了全球安全界的激烈讨论，但攻击的机制仍然未知。

在接下来的两个月里，技术细节仍然仅限于微软安全公告中的信息，并且没有第三方公开重现该攻击。 现在，我们的人工智能安全系统 Deepsec 中的 PoC 代理首次重建了每一个步骤，并生成了该漏洞的工作复制品。

传统补丁分析的局限性

分析 Microsoft 和 Apple 等供应商的安全补丁是企业和关键基础设施组织内安全计划的重要组成部分。 这项工作帮助团队确定漏洞对现实世界的影响，评估攻击者将漏洞武器化的速度，独立验证补丁是否完全解决了根本问题，并开发检测和缓解能力。

然而，在这种情况下，漏洞被隐藏在庞大的 Edge 代码库中，单个二进制模块超过 300 MB。 在这种规模上应用传统的二进制差异需要大量的专家努力。 将目标模块及其调试符号加载到IDA等工具中后，生成的IDB可达5GB，使得分析极其耗时。

此外，编译器优化和函数重新排序引入的非语义变化会产生大量与目标漏洞无关的噪声。 在此 Edge 更新中，易受攻击的版本和修补版本之间有超过 32,000 个功能存在差异，这使得安全关键修复更加难以隔离。

与内存损坏漏洞不同，逻辑错误在很大程度上取决于代码上下文和应用程序语义。 孤立地检查更改的功能很少足以重建其完整的安全含义。

我们随后的审查发现，该边缘漏洞利用链中的逻辑错误分布在几个不相关的模块中，包括导航验证、异步选项卡选择和反馈日志处理。 即使在找到单个修复程序之后，也很难确定底层漏洞提供了哪些利用原语，更不用说如何将其与其他漏洞链接起来了。

在我们的研究过程中，我们发现人工智能显着加速了语义分析和跨模块关系的发现。 基于这一见解，我们在 deepsec 中实现了自动化差异分析框架，将二进制差异工具、PoC Agent 平台和 DARKNAVY 的安全研究知识库集成到统一的工作流程中。

我们使用这个复杂的边缘漏洞利用链作为测试用例，以确定 Deepsec 是否可以仅使用补丁前和补丁后的二进制文件以及 Microsoft 提供的有限信息来重建完整的链。

从头开始向后工作：路径遍历文件写入原语

面对未知的漏洞利用链，deepsec 从最后开始，使用漏洞建议来识别具有最清晰预期行为的原语。

deepsec 首先在 Edge 的反馈组件中发现了一个明确的安全修复：存在漏洞的版本中的文件写入功能已从修补版本中删除。 进一步分析表明，易受攻击的接口包含路径遍历缺陷，提供了漏洞利用链末端所需的任意文件写入原语。 通过其他利用技术，该原语可以转变为 Windows 上的远程代码执行。

deepsec还确定了触发易受攻击接口的前提条件：攻击者需要在暴露edgeFeedbackPrivate API的特权页面上执行JavaScript。

漏洞利用链的最后一部分现在已经很清楚了：

特权页面执行JavaScript → 调用edgeFeedbackPrivate API → 通过路径遍历写入文件 → Windows RCE

下一个问题是攻击者如何从普通网页访问此特权执行环境。

打破导航限制：任意 URL 导航

根据该通报提到的“导航处理”，deepsec 对相关组件进行了有针对性的差异分析。 它找到了 CA Guidance 导航组件并确定了多个安全修复程序，其中最重要的更改集中在 EdgeCAGuidanceNavigationThrottle::WillStartRequest 中。

漏洞版本直接使用switch_profile参数作为导航目标，没有限制javascript:等特殊方案。 修补版本引入了 URL 方案白名单。

导航源验证也发生了变化。 易受攻击的版本称为 GetVisibleURL，用于检索选项卡中当前显示的 URL，并使用它来确定导航是否源自 Microsoft 登录页面。 修补后的版本改为调用 GetInitiatorOrigin 来验证导航的实际启动器。

乍一看，这似乎是一个简单的更改，其中使用 URL 源进行验证。 然而，deepsec 发现了两种方法的安全隐患之间存在微妙但重要的区别：在易受攻击的版本中，不受信任的上下文可以控制正在验证 URL 的页面的导航。

攻击者可以首先将其控制下的选项卡导航到 Microsoft 登录页面，然后从不受信任的上下文触发后续导航。 这意味着其可见 URL 通过验证的选项卡可能与启动导航的上下文不同，从而允许攻击者绕过源限制。

然而，即使绕过源验证，渲染器进程仍然无法直接导航到edge://guidance-ca-error。 因此，漏洞利用链的入口点仍然被阻止。

Deepsec 的进一步分析发现了一个未修补的验证间隙，可用于输入相同的处理路径：该组件仅比较条目 URL 的主机，而不验证其方案。 因此，攻击者可以使用 https://guidance-ca-error/ 来达到相同的逻辑，绕过渲染器对直接导航到特权 Edge:// 方案的限制。 一旦进入该流程，攻击者就可以将 switch_profile 设置为特权页面或 javascript: URL。

恶意页面 → CA 指导导航 → 任意 URL 导航 → javascript: URL 或特权页面

deepsec 现在有一个任意的 URL 导航原语，但这仍然不足以完成漏洞利用。

最后一部分：实现 UXSS

迄今为止发现的漏洞表明了攻击的总体方向：

导航验证绕过 → UXSS → 特权 API 访问 → 路径遍历文件写入

仍然缺少一个关键部分。

攻击者可以从 Microsoft 登录页面启动任意导航，通过 javascript: URL 在当前页面上执行代码，或导航到特权页面。 但是，这些功能无法直接组合。 导航到公开 EdgeFeedbackPrivate API 的特权页面后，攻击者仍然需要一种在该页面上下文中执行 JavaScript 的方法。

一时间，deepsec的分析陷入了僵局。

deepsec 还在其他模块中发现了一些可疑的修复。 例如，QuickAuth 的易受攻击版本缺乏对导航目标的必要限制，而修补版本则引入了目标白名单和其他安全检查。 随着候选人数量的增加，确定真正的漏洞利用路径变得越来越困难。

此时，deepsec 必须像人类研究人员一样对候选者进行优先级排序：哪些修复代表了相邻攻击面中的独立问题，哪些更改可以提供当前漏洞利用链中缺失的链接？

在并行探索多个方向后，deepsec 得出结论，QuickAuth 和其他候选者缺乏利用所需的条件。 因此，其后续分析的重点是 CA 指导路径。

通过跟踪 HandleCAErrorPageGuidance 的下游流程，deepsec 发现了整个链中最微妙的缺陷：对象绑定错误。

当 email 参数与当前配置文件匹配时，HandleCAErrorPageGuidance 使用异步 PostTask 导航到 switch_profile 指定的 URL。

在存在漏洞的版本中，lambda 捕获了引用浏览器窗口的 WeakPtr<Browser> 。 导航使用 CURRENT_TAB 配置，但未绑定到特定选项卡。 在运行时，Navigate 调用 GetActiveWebContents 来检索当时处于活动状态的选项卡并在那里执行导航。

修补后的版本改为捕获特定选项卡的 WeakPtr<WebContents>，确保目标 URL 加载到同一选项卡中。

乍一看，这似乎是一个没有明显安全意义的实现细节。 然而，在漏洞利用链的上下文中，deepsec 认识到该漏洞的实现破坏了通过安全检查的对象与最终执行操作的对象之间的绑定。

由于 lambda 是异步执行的，因此浏览器的活动选项卡可能会在任务发布时间和运行时间之间发生变化。 因此，可见 URL 通过 Microsoft 登录检查的选项卡和最终执行 JavaScript 的选项卡不必相同。

攻击者可以构建多阶段导航序列：首先，将一个选项卡导航到 Microsoft 登录页面，以便其可见 URL 通过验证；然后，在执行异步任务之前，将特权目标页面设置为活动选项卡。

这允许攻击者在暴露 EdgeFeedbackPrivate API 的特权页面上下文中执行任意 JavaScript，从而完成 UXSS 原语。

完整的漏洞利用链现已完成。 首先，攻击者从恶意页面启动 CA Guidance 导航，并利用条目 URL 的仅主机验证来到达相关处理路径。 接下来，攻击者绕过有缺陷的导航源验证和缺失的目标方案限制来获取任意 URL 导航。 最后，攻击者利用异步导航流中的对象绑定错误来切换活动选项卡并在暴露 EdgeFeedbackPrivate API 的特权页面上执行 JavaScript。 由此，攻击者可以调用存在漏洞的反馈接口，利用路径遍历写入任意文件，最终在Windows上实现远程代码执行。

Deepsec 随后在 Windows 虚拟机中开发并调试了一个有效的漏洞，验证了整个链。

结论

该实验表明，deepsec 可以结合补丁比较、语义分析、浏览器安全知识和动态验证来重建各个漏洞利用原语并确定它们如何组合在一起 - 即使公共信息稀缺，目标二进制文件异常大，并且漏洞跨越不相关的组件。

Microsoft 等上游供应商发布安全补丁并不意味着每个端点都会立即受到保护。 大型企业通常需要完成测试、部署和系统重启才能全面推出更新，从而留下可能持续数天甚至数月的暴露窗口。

过去，下游组织经常相信攻击者将难以快速重建复杂的漏洞，并且大规模利用的成本仍然高昂。

然而，随着人工智能驱动的安全能力不断成熟，补丁发布和成功武器化之间的时间将大幅缩短。

围绕这个时间间隔建立的防御可能很快就会不再可靠。
